abstract: In patients with trophoblastic tumors, changes in immuno-capacity through their clinical courses were examined, by 1) 3H-thymidine uptake by PHA-stimulated peripheral lymphocytes using whole blood microculture assay (common cellular immunity), and 2) the effects of patients' sera to 3H-thymidine uptake by PHA-stimulated peripheral blood lymphocytes (humoral factor). Hydatidiform mole: After molar delivery, cellular immunity accelerated, and humoral suppressive factor significantly increased. Invasive mole: No significant change was observed in the cellular immunity, but humoral suppressive factors increased gradually as the therapies proceeded. And the suppressive apex came at about the 60th day of admission, but these factors decreased afterwards. Choriocarcinoma: At initial time, cellular immunity accelerated significantly, and from the 60th day to the 90th day of admission, this cellular immunity declined significantly compared with that in the pretreated state. But cellular immunity was not entirely eliminated by the courses of treatment. The humoral suppressive apex came at about the 120th day of admission. Nevertheless, where death unfortunately occurred, humoral suppressive factors were not so numerous. As a whole, from the viewpoint of immunotherapy in patients with choriocarcinoma, common immunity which was observed in this study did not decline, so that specific immunotherapy must be regarded as likely kept in mind.
abstract_ja: 絨毛性腫瘍の患者について、臨床経過を通じた免疫能の変化を次の方法で検討した：1) 全血微量培養法を用いたPHA刺激末梢リンパ球の3H-チミジン取込み（細胞性免疫）、2) 患者血清がPHA刺激末梢血リンパ球の3H-チミジン取込みに及ぼす影響（液性因子）。胞状奇胎：分娩後に細胞性免疫が亢進し、液性抑制因子は有意に増加した。侵入奇胎：細胞性免疫に有意な変化は認められなかったが、治療の進行とともに液性抑制因子が徐々に増加した。抑制のピークは入院後約60日目に見られたが、その後これらの因子は減少した。絨毛癌：初期には細胞性免疫が有意に亢進した。入院後60日目から90日目にかけて、この細胞性免疫は治療前と比べ有意に低下した。しかし治療の経過を経ても細胞性免疫は完全には消失しなかった。液性抑制のピークは入院後約120日目に見られた。死亡例では液性抑制因子は多くなかった。全体として、絨毛癌患者の免疫療法の観点からは、本研究で観察された共通の細胞性免疫は低下しなかったため、特異的免疫療法の可能性を考慮すべきと考えられる。
